newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bourse to resume trade after interruption.
newsitem.headline: German bourse to resume trade after interruption.

text.p: The German stock exchange said on Wednesday that trade on its IBIS dax share index would resume in full at 0915 GMT after technical difficulties interrupted dealing earlier.
The bourse said it was in a pre-trade testing phase while the problems were sorted out. A spokesman for the stock exchange said the technical problems had first occurred at around 0850 GMT.
